newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia Airlines to fly Tel Aviv charter Aug 31.
newsitem.headline: Croatia Airlines to fly Tel Aviv charter Aug 31.

text.p: State carrier Croatia Airlines d.d. said on Thursday it would fly to Israeli capital Tel Aviv on August 31.
It said in a statement the flight was a charter, departing Zagreb at 1830 local (1630 GMT) via Istanbul to pick up a group of 100 Israeli tourists for a week's holiday in Croatia.
It was to arrive at Tel Aviv airport minutes after midnight, flying back via Athens to Split on the Adriatic coast. Arrival time was planned at 0500 on Sunday.
The company said earlier its tourist flights this summer would help significantly improve passanger numbers, boosting the 1996 performance.
